fields.description: Program Description 1. Period of Study After formal admission, students will have a full-time study for 4 years in China University of Political Science and Law (CUPL). 2. Specialized required courses An Introduction To Sociology Higher Mathematics 1 Higher Mathematics 2 Sociological Theories Abrad 1 Social Psychology Survey Of Social Work Sociological Theories Abroad 2 Chinese Society Social Research Methods Theories Of Western Contemporary Sociology Social Anthropology English For Sociology Statistical Software Applications Political Sociology Ecnomic Sociology Development Sociology Social Stratification And Flows Public required courses Fundamentals of Computer Applications An Introduction to Chinese Civilization An Introduction to Western Civilization Chinese-1 Chinses-2 General Introduction to China 3. Tuition and Application Fee of the Preparatory Courses Tuition is 20,000 RMB per year; application fee is 660 RMB. Those whose Chinese proficiency is under HSK level 5, without receiving preparatory courses and intend to directly enter bachelor's degree study need to pay the application service fee 10,000 RMB (including the related costs used for: Chinese courses, major courses, guidance to studying abroad, selection of majors and completion of relevant procedures etc.). 4. Accommodations Students can live in the students’ apartments arranged by the School of International Education, or solve accommodations by themselves. 5. Scholarship Foreign students will obtain "the scholarship for freshmen", once they are admitted by our university as freshmen.
fields.fees: Fee Structure Tuition Fee Bachelor RMB 20,000 per year RMB 80,000 in total (About $ 11,174) Accommodation Fee Residence Hall Number One Studio RMB 3 to RMB 25 (More Details) CUPL International Student Communication Center Double Room RMB 30 (More Details) Studio RMB 15 (More Details) Other Fees Application Fee USD 57 to USD 113 Service Fee USD 200 Living Expense(Per Month) RMB 1,500 to RMB 2,000
fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Certification of no criminal record * 2. Physical examination record for foreigner * 3. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included * 4. Four two-inch photos * 5. High school academic transcript Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 6. High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 7. If the applicant is under the age of 18, he/she should submit relevant legal documents of his/her legal guardian in China. * 8. Certificate of HSK * 9. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Non-Chinese citizens 2. Undergraduate programs applicants should be 18 to 25 age. 3. Senior high school graduation. 4. HSK Band 4 Certificate.
